covenants.source_quote: Leverage in respect of any Relevant Period shall not exceed 3.00:1 for each Relevant Period ending on or before 31 December 2026 and 2.50:1 thereafter.
Interest Cover in respect of any Relevant Period shall not be less than 3.00:1.

facility.source_quote: Termination Date means 31 March 2028. Margin means 3.00 per cent. per annum.
